Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live''

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
TABLE. OBSTETRIC, LABOUR 



1. Scope — Dimensions and other requirements for obstetric labour table. 

2. Material 

2.1 Tube — As given In 2.1 of IS : 4033-19:8 •Ganerai requirem2nts for hospital furniture '. 

2.2 Top — As given In 2.2(a) of IS : 4033-1968. 

2.3 Channel Support — Mild steel, cold-rolled or hot-rolled quality. 

2*4 Lithotomy Rods — Stainless steel, designation 04Crl9Nl9 or 07Crl9Nl9of Schedule V of IS: 1570-1961 
* Schedules for wrought steels for general engineering purposes *. 

3. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. I. 

4. Manufacture — The obstetric labour table shall have a welded framework of continuous lengths of mild 
steel tubes as shown In Fig. I. The four upright members shall be connected at the floor end by a pair of 
longitudinal and a pair of transverse tubes. The upright members shall support a formed metal top with 
perineal cut-out. The arrangement for welding the sheet metal tops and the uprights may be employed but 
the construction so obtained shall be sturdy and sound. The sheet metal top shall have channel supports as 
shown In Fig. I or as agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier. On the perineal cut-out side the 
table shall have arrangement for receiving twd^^ltfiotomy rods In two different positions with distances of 
350 and 500 mm between the rods. The tablejrhall be free from burrs, sharp edges. The floor ends of the 
uprights shall be fitted with aluminium shoesT The rest of the details shall ba according to 4.1 of IS : 4033- 
1968. y 

5. Finish — As specified In 5 of IS : 4033-1968. 

6. Adhesion Test — Shall be conducted as prescrib2d in 6.1.1 of IS : 4033-I9S8. 
?• Marl<ing — As specified in 7.1 of IS : 4033-1968. 

7.1 Certification Marking — DetaWs available with the Bureau of Indian Standards. 
8. Packing — As agreed to between the purchaser and the manufacturer.
